rule.name: HashCodeDisagreesWithEquals
rule.message: This hashCode reads a field that equals does not compare, or returns the identity hash (super.hashCode()) although equals compares fields, so two objects that are equal get different hashes and HashSet and HashMap lookups, remove and contains miss them. Build both from the same fields: hashCode may use a subset of what equals compares, never more. Keep mutable state out of both: equals compares listener, hashCode returns Objects.hash(listener).
